text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The showdown between BNW was so
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Wasn't Narita Taishin amazing?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right? That was some awesome
sprinting! Was she
always so fast?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(And on top of that, Taishin was
awesome...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Her sprint was so strong, it freaked me
out!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (What if this was the Derby?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaa! I can't be a coward now! No,
no, nope!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERRRBYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What's with her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I suspect she's quite disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Either way... I can't afford to lose the
next race.
I'll take every necessary
precaution.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll do a proper analysis of today's
match—in
detail.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Heh. If it makes you feel better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of BNW's intense race at the
Satsuki Sho
spread like wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, more fans than ever were
clamoring
to get seats for their next
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time. Next up is the Japanese Derby,
Winning
Ticket's dream race!
